description: Manus's desktop agent through its cask, and ChatGPT Atlas's last build from OpenAI's own URL.
why: Atlas's bundle id is its only witness, since a direct download leaves no Homebrew record. Manus also matches on the brew route, so must_find would pass with its bundle id broken; must_contain names im.manus.desktop for that reason. chatgpt-desktop is forbidden because Atlas shares its com.openai. namespace, and the AI browsers already catalogued because Atlas is another Chromium browser.
known_gaps: Neither app is launched: Manus's computer-use and capture helpers, which its cask's uninstall stanza names as launchd jobs, and Atlas's update helper are never registered, so no launchd value is read.
The chatgpt-atlas cask is disabled, so its Homebrew token, which machines that installed it before 2026-08-26 still report, cannot be produced and is not catalogued.
Manus's Windows build is not installed anywhere.
